mapper.insert: insert into sh_comment (order_id, idle_id, buyer_id, seller_id, rating, content, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{idleId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: select * from sh_comment where idle_id = #{idleId} order by create_time desc
select count(*) from sh_comment where order_id = #{orderId}

and ( c.content like concat('%', #{searchValue}, '%') or c.id = #{searchValue} or u.nickname like concat('%', #{searchValue}, '%') or i.idle_name like concat('%', #{searchValue}, '%') )
